svg.title: A through-hole pad in a plane: solid, and with thermal relief
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, top side of the board. In both, the copper plane is under the solder mask and only the pad's mask opening is bare. Left: the pad is joined to the plane all round, so the plane draws heat away as fast as the soldering tool supplies it, and the opening shows copper right to its edge. Right: the same pad separated from the plane by a clearance ring and joined to it by four thin spokes, which keep the heat in the joint; the opening shows the pad, a little bare FR4 and the ends of the spokes.

g.text: Copper right to the opening's edge
Longer and narrower keep more heat in
Drawn to scale. Use spokes on every layer the pad connects to (PCB-DFA-044).
